stemMd: Choose the best transition: "Some residents reach the park by bicycle. ___, others arrive on foot from nearby apartment buildings."
explanationMd: Both sentences describe residents arriving without cars. A similarity transition connects these parallel examples without inventing a causal or adversarial relationship.

distractorRationale.c: Walking does not contradict the fact that others cycle.
distractorRationale.b: The two groups are parallel examples, not a replacement decision by one group.
distractorRationale.d: Cyclists do not cause other residents to walk.
